signal: BoomPop raised $41M led by Wing VC in November 2025 to scale its AI-powered platform for company events, having powered 60,000+ hotel nights

email.body1:
Simon, saw BoomPop raised $41M led by Wing VC to scale your AI platform for company events.

A raise that size usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is exactly where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BoomPop off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Simon, quick follow-up for BoomPop.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BoomPop needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Simon, last bit of proof for BoomPop.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BoomPop's reply rate likely compares to other recently funded startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Simon, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to BoomPop either way.
